responsibility_name: Support waking with morning daylight when oversleeping

evidence.evidence_text: When it's 7:00 a.m. and the person stays in bed for more than 15 minutes then the blinds go up.

Assuming the house has an entrance door with a smart handle that recognizes me through a cell phone signal or something similar. Make the door open as soon as I'm in front of him. Without me having the keys to the house.
If the tv is on and if it is 11.30pm, turn off the tv and set a voice message to Alexa

responsibility_name: Ensure a lit unattended stove is shut off promptly

evidence.evidence_text: If the stove remains lit in the kitchen and nobody is there, a notification arrives on the telephone and the stove is switched off.

responsibility_name: Ensure house keys are remembered before leaving

evidence.evidence_text: If I open the front door and try to pass through it without the RFID key fob, the internal intercom warns me to remember to take the house keys.

responsibility_name: Ensure safe passage on stairs at night

evidence.evidence_text: If the time is between 18 and 5 in the morning and if the weight on the stairs is greater than 10 kg, then turn on the spotlights

responsibility_name: Ensure the fridge door is not left open

evidence.evidence_text: If the fridge remains open, send a message to your mobile phone

responsibility_name: Ensure the full bin is put out on collection day

evidence.evidence_text: If the bin is full and if it is waste collection day then the system will send an SMS to my mobile phone with a sound notification
There is a function in the house that senses the presence of human inhabitants. When there are NO tenants in the house, the intercom and the telephone will be silenced so as not to upset the dogs.

responsibility_name: Keep the unoccupied home monitored against unauthorized entry

evidence.evidence_text: When the door is opened if the house is empty, a text message is sent to the owner and a pre-alarm beep is activated.
IF NOT someone is detected in the house AND IF all lights are off ARM the burglar alarm AND CLOSE all windows.

When the user takes the penultimate item of a certain type from the pantry, if no orders have already been placed on Amazon and if the monthly statement is less than € 300, order the missing products on Amazon and notify the user on the mobile phone
When the chlorine in the pool is less than 1 Send notification

responsibility_name: monitor home remotely for suspicious activity

evidence.evidence_text: When I'm not at home, activate all the video cameras and in case of suspicious movements, send me a message on my mobile phone with the video recording.
when you open the fridge if it has been open for 3 minutes, close the fridge
